issue.title: Fix tests on PHP 8

repository.name: commonmark
repository.description: Highly-extensible PHP Markdown parser which fully supports the CommonMark and GFM specs.

issue.body: "match" is now a semi-reserved keyword in PHP 8, so we need the patch from https://github.com/sebastianbergmann/phpunit/pull/4374 in order for our tests to run.

body:
You can manually run the Composer command that `simple-phpunit` uses to see what's happening.

Using Composer 1:

```bash
$ composer info --no-ansi -a -n phpunit/phpunit "9.3.*" | grep versions
versions : 9.3.x-dev

$ composer info --no-ansi -a -n phpunit/phpunit "9.2.*" | grep versions
versions : 9.2.x-dev, 9.2.6, 9.2.5, 9.2.4, 9.2.3, 9.2.2, 9.2.1, 9.2.0
```

Using Composer 2:

```bash
$ composer info --no-ansi -a -n phpunit/phpunit "9.3.*" | grep versions
versions : dev-master, 9.3.x-dev

$ composer info --no-ansi -a -n phpunit/phpunit "9.2.*" | grep versions
versions : 9.2.x-dev, 9.2.6, 9.2.5, 9.2.4, 9.2.3, 9.2.2, 9.2.1, 9.2.0
```

Note that Composer 2 shows two dev versions for 9.3.
I think we just need to filter out `dev-*` and `*-dev` names, and see if the count is zero, to determine if `-s dev` is needed.

issue.title: Fix checks for phpunit releases on Composer 2
issue.body:
| Q             | A
| ------------- | ---
| Branch?       | 3.4
| Bug fix?      | yes
| New feature?  | no
| Deprecations? | no
| Tickets       | Fix #37601
| License       | MIT
| Doc PR        | n/a

`simple-phpunit` has a core assumption that any version of PHPUnit without a stable release will only have one dev version returned by Composer.  Per https://github.com/symfony/symfony/issues/37601, it's possible for Composer 2 to list **more than one dev version**.  This breaks that assumption and therefore prevents the installation of 9.3.* ([which is needed for testing on PHP 8](https://github.com/sebastianbergmann/phpunit/pull/4374#issuecomment-657029594)).

The fix implemented here is to remove any versions containing `dev-` or `-dev` from the list of possible versions to see if any stable versions remain.

body: Good idea!  I've submitted https://github.com/symfony/symfony/pull/37607 with that fix.
